# 2 Chronicles Chapter 13 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** In-year eighteen of-the-king Jeroboam and-he-reigned Abijah over Judah.

**2** Three years he-reigned in-Jerusalem and-name-of his-mother was-Micaiah daughter-of Uriel from-Gibeah and-war was between Abijah and-Jeroboam.

**3** And-he-tied Abijah the-battle with-an-army-of mighty-men-of war four-hundred thousand men chosen and-Jeroboam arrayed against-him battle with-eight-hundred thousand men chosen mighty-men-of valor.

**4** And-he-stood-up Abijah on-Mount Zemaraim that is-in-hill-country-of Ephraim and-he-said hear-me Jeroboam and-all Israel.

**5** Is-it-not for-you to-know that YHWH God-of Israel gave the-kingdom over Israel to-David forever to-him and-to-his-sons by-a-covenant-of salt.

**6** And-he-rose-up Jeroboam son-of Nebat servant-of Solomon son-of David and-he-rebelled against his-lord.

**7** And-they-gathered to-him men empty worthless and-they-strengthened-themselves against Rehoboam son-of Solomon and-Rehoboam was young and-tender-of heart and-not he-strengthened-himself before-them.

**8** And-now you are-saying to-strengthen-yourselves before kingdom-of YHWH in-hand-of sons-of David and-you are-a-multitude great and-with-you calves-of gold that made for-you Jeroboam for-gods.

**9** Did-not you-drive-out priests-of YHWH sons-of Aaron and-the-Levites and-you-made for-yourselves priests like-peoples-of the-lands every-one-who-comes to-fill his-hand with-a-bull young and-rams seven and-he-becomes a-priest to-not-gods.

**10** And-we YHWH is-our-God and-not we-forsook-Him and-priests serving YHWH sons-of Aaron and-the-Levites in-the-work.

**11** And-burning to-YHWH burnt-offerings morning by-morning and-evening by-evening and-incense-of spices and-arrangement-of bread on the-table the-pure and-lampstand-of the-gold and-its-lamps to-burn evening by-evening for we-are-keeping charge-of YHWH our-God and-you you-forsook-Him.

**12** And-behold with-us at-the-head God and-His-priests and-trumpets-of the-alarm to-sound-the-alarm against-you sons-of Israel do-not fight against YHWH God-of your-fathers for not you-will-succeed.

**13** And-Jeroboam brought-around the-ambush to-come from-behind-them and-they-were before Judah and-the-ambush was-from-behind-them.

**14** And-they-turned Judah and-behold to-them the-battle from-the-face and-from-behind and-they-cried to-YHWH and-the-priests were-blowing with-the-trumpets.

**15** And-they-shouted men-of Judah and-it-was as-shouted men-of Judah and-God struck Jeroboam and-all Israel before Abijah and-Judah.

**16** And-they-fled sons-of Israel from-before Judah and-He-gave-them God in-their-hand.

**17** And-he-struck against-them Abijah and-his-people a-striking great and-they-fell slain from-Israel five-hundred thousand men chosen.

**18** And-they-were-humbled sons-of Israel at-the-time that and-they-were-strong sons-of Judah for they-leaned on YHWH God-of their-fathers.

**19** And-he-pursued Abijah after Jeroboam and-he-captured from-him cities Bethel and-its-daughters and-Jeshanah and-its-daughters and-Ephron and-its-daughters.

**20** And-not retained Jeroboam strength anymore in-days-of Abijah and-He-struck-him YHWH and-he-died.

**21** And-he-strengthened-himself Abijah and-he-took for-himself wives fourteen and-he-fathered sons twenty-and-two and-daughters sixteen.

**22** And-rest-of acts-of Abijah and-his-ways and-his-words are-written in-midrash-of the-prophet Iddo.


---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **13:5**: covenant-of salt — Salt symbolizes permanence and inviolability. The Davidic covenant is presented as eternally binding, like a salt-preserved treaty.

- **13:9**: to-fill his-hand — Idiom for priestly ordination. Jeroboam created a democratized priesthood where anyone with sufficient offerings could serve — abolishing Aaronic exclusivity.

- **13:18**: they-leaned on YHWH — The verb sha'an (to lean/rely) captures the Chronicler's ideal: military victory comes from dependence on God, not numerical superiority.


— EMET
